text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl got hurt, so I rushed 
her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... There's no need to look so 
anxious.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I understand why you feel 
rushed. It just shows how serious you are 
about our dream, after all."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, why don't we try going for a 
light run? If we see how much you can 
move, we might be able to set a target for 
your comeback, right?"
choice_data_list: No, I don't want you overdoing it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then look forward to it! Look forward to 
my return... shining bright like a flower 
pearl!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes! Come on, let's head to the track!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It looks like it hurts even with 
this much. That limits what I can do, but—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Going any further will only breed 
anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, she would be taking some time off 
to rest...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I can run without any issues. 
Looks like my return to the track will go 
smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"As long as you don't lose hope, you can 
keep shining no matter what..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This is my answer to your feelings!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her strong willpower, Seeking 
the Pearl made a smooth comeback.
